text: B.A. Credit Management Objectives: The Credit Management specialty aims to train students with a high quality of professional knowledge to meet the need of the construction of the Socialist Market Economy and the need of many other fields concerned with securities, insurance, credit management, etc. Object: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree Main courses: Political Economy, Macro-Economics, Micro-Economics, Accounting, Monetary and Banking, , Insurance, Financial， Stock Investment, Business and Operation of Commercial Bank, Trust Management, Credit Risk Management, Trust Management of Enterprise and Individual, Credit Rating, Assets Evaluation, etc.
